unit: physical complete race; not horses, history lines or metadata references
rationale: Initial coverage screening floor, not statistical power or model-promotion authority. Race-cluster samples in both countries and all seasons prevent a single-track/day sample being called representative. 1000/200/200 is a frozen prospective audit minimum; final statistical power belongs to separately authorized Phase 3. No outcomes or ROI are used to choose this standard.
authority: REPORT_ONLY; existing admission, holdout and model policies unchanged; does not authorize training
